records.treatment_principle_en: Tonify lung qi
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with white coating
records.mechanism_zh: 肺氣虛弱,宣發肅降無力,故咳嗽無力、氣短;肺主皮毛,衛外不固,故自汗、易感冒;肺氣不足,聲門失養,故聲低懶言。
records.mechanism_en: Weakened Lung Qi loses its power to disperse and descend, producing a weak cough and shortness of breath; since the Lung governs the skin and body hair, a weakened defensive (Wei) function leads to spontaneous sweating and susceptibility to colds.
records.common_causes_zh: 久咳傷肺、脾虛不能生金、稟賦不足、久病體虛
records.common_causes_en: Chronic cough injuring the Lung, Spleen deficiency failing to generate Lung Qi, congenital weakness, chronic illness
records.progression_zh: 肺氣虛可累及脾(肺脾兩虛)或心(心肺氣虛);氣虛及陰,可發展為肺氣陰兩虛。
records.progression_en: Lung Qi Deficiency may involve the Spleen or Heart; if Qi deficiency extends to Yin it can progress to combined Lung Qi and Yin Deficiency.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肺氣虛以咳嗽無力、痰清稀、自汗為主,無熱象;肺陰虛以乾咳少痰、潮熱盜汗、舌紅少苔為主,屬虛熱。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Lung Qi Deficiency shows a weak cough with thin sputum and no heat signs; Lung Yin Deficiency shows a dry cough with scant sputum, tidal fever, and night sweats — a deficiency-heat pattern.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 氣虛舌淡;陰虛舌紅少苔
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肺氣虛為內傷虛證,病程較久,無表證;風寒犯肺為外感實證,起病急,兼惡寒發熱、脈浮緊等表證。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Lung Qi Deficiency is a chronic internal-damage deficiency pattern with no exterior signs; Wind-Cold Invading the Lung is an acute exterior excess pattern with chills, fever, and a floating tight pulse.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Nourish Yin, moisten the Lungs, clear Heat, stop cough
records.short_summary_zh: 肺陰虧虛，虛熱內生，肺失清肅。以乾咳少痰、痰中帶血、口乾咽燥、五心煩熱、午後潮熱、盜汗為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Depletion of Lung Yin leading to internal Deficiency-Heat and loss of Lung moistening function. Characterized by dry cough with little sputum, blood-streaked sputum, dry throat, tidal fever, and night sweats.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 肺系虛熱證：乾咳少痰、痰中帶血、潮熱盜汗為三大診斷要點。多由久咳傷陰、熱病後期傷津引發。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Lung System Deficiency-Heat: Key features are dry cough, blood-streaked sputum, and night sweats. Caused by chronic cough or febrile fluid depletion.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr Lung Pathology & NCCAOM 考點：代表方百合固金湯 (Bai He Gu Jin Tang) 或沙參麥冬湯。主穴：LU9 太淵、KI6 照海、LU5 尺澤、BL13 肺俞。
records.tongue_en: Red tongue body with scanty coating and dry fluids

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肺陰虛以乾咳少痰、潮熱盜汗、舌紅少苔為主;肺氣虛以咳嗽無力、痰清稀、自汗為主,無熱象。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Lung Yin Deficiency shows a dry cough, tidal fever, and night sweats; Lung Qi Deficiency shows a weak cough with thin sputum and no heat signs.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 陰虛舌紅少苔;氣虛舌淡
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.mechanism_zh: 肺陰虧虛，肺失濡潤與清肅，並可內生虛熱，故見乾咳少痰、咽燥與潮熱盜汗。
records.mechanism_en: Depleted Lung Yin fails to moisten the Lung and support its descending function, while Deficiency-Heat may arise internally, producing a dry scanty cough, dry throat, tidal fever, and night sweats.
records.common_causes_zh: 久咳傷陰；熱病後期耗傷津液。
records.common_causes_en: Chronic cough injuring Yin; depletion of fluids during the late stage of a febrile illness.
records.progression_zh: 陰液進一步耗傷時，虛熱可加重，午後潮熱、盜汗或痰中帶血可更明顯。
records.progression_en: With further Yin and fluid depletion, Deficiency-Heat may intensify, making afternoon tidal fever, night sweats, or blood-streaked sputum more evident.
supporting_signs_en: Afternoon tidal fever or five-center heat

records.treatment_principle_en: Release the exterior with warm acrid herbs, diffuse the lung
records.tongue_en: Thin white tongue coating
records.mechanism_zh: 風寒外襲,束於肌表,衛陽被遏,故惡寒發熱、無汗、頭身疼痛;風寒犯肺,肺氣失宣,故咳嗽、鼻塞流清涕。
records.mechanism_en: Wind-Cold invades the exterior, binding the surface and obstructing the defensive Yang — producing chills, fever, absence of sweating, and body aches; when it reaches the Lung, Lung Qi loses its dispersing function, producing cough and nasal congestion with clear discharge.
records.common_causes_zh: 外感風寒之邪、氣候驟變、衛外不固
records.common_causes_en: External invasion by Wind-Cold, sudden weather change, weakened defensive Qi
records.progression_zh: 表邪不解可入裡化熱,轉為風熱犯肺或肺熱證;素體肺虛者易反覆感邪。
records.progression_en: Unresolved exterior pathogens may transform into interior heat, shifting toward Wind-Heat or Lung Heat patterns; those with underlying Lung Qi deficiency are prone to recurrent invasion.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風寒犯肺惡寒重、發熱輕、無汗、痰白清稀、苔薄白、脈浮緊;風熱犯肺發熱重、惡寒輕、有汗、痰黏黃、苔薄黃、脈浮數。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Cold shows predominant chills, no sweating, thin white sputum, and a floating tight pulse; Wind-Heat shows predominant fever, sweating, sticky yellow sputum, and a floating rapid pulse.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 風寒苔薄白;風熱舌尖紅苔薄黃
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 風寒脈浮緊;風熱脈浮數

records.treatment_principle_en: Release the exterior with cool acrid herbs, clear lung heat
records.tongue_en: Red tip with thin yellow coating
records.mechanism_zh: 風熱外襲,犯及肺衛,故發熱較重、微惡寒、有汗;熱邪上炎,咽喉不利,故咽喉紅腫疼痛;肺失清肅,故咳嗽痰黃黏稠。
records.mechanism_en: Wind-Heat invades the Lung and defensive layer, producing predominant fever with mild chills and sweating; the ascending heat causes a red, swollen, sore throat, while the Lung's clearing/descending function is impaired, producing a cough with sticky yellow sputum.
records.common_causes_zh: 外感風熱之邪、季節氣候偏熱、風寒鬱久化熱
records.common_causes_en: External invasion by Wind-Heat, seasonal warm weather, or prolonged Wind-Cold transforming into heat
records.progression_zh: 熱邪深入可傳氣分,發展為痰熱壅肺或肺熱壅盛重證。
records.progression_en: If unresolved, the heat can penetrate deeper (Qi level) and progress to Phlegm-Heat Obstructing the Lung or a more severe Lung Heat pattern.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風熱犯肺發熱重、有汗、痰黃、苔薄黃、脈浮數;風寒犯肺惡寒重、無汗、痰白、苔薄白、脈浮緊。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Heat shows predominant fever, sweating, and yellow sputum with a floating rapid pulse; Wind-Cold shows predominant chills, no sweating, and white sputum with a floating tight pulse.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風熱犯肺為表證初起,病位較淺;痰熱壅肺為熱邪入裡,痰黃稠量多、胸痛喘促,病位在肺臟本身,程度較重。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Heat Invading the Lung is an early exterior pattern; Phlegm-Heat Obstructing the Lung is a deeper interior pattern with copious thick yellow sputum, chest pain, and marked dyspnea.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Dry damp, transform phlegm, diffuse the lung
supporting_signs_en: Poor appetite, abdominal distention, edema may accompany
records.tongue_en: White, greasy tongue coating
records.mechanism_zh: 脾失健運,水濕內停,聚而成痰,上貯於肺,肺失宣降,故咳嗽痰多、胸悶、喘促;此為「脾為生痰之源,肺為貯痰之器」的典型表現。
records.mechanism_en: Spleen dysfunction allows Dampness to accumulate and condense into Phlegm, which is stored in the Lung and impairs its dispersing/descending function — the classic 'Spleen generates Phlegm, Lung stores it' mechanism, producing a productive cough, chest fullness and dyspnea.
records.common_causes_zh: 脾虛生濕、飲食不節、久咳傷肺、外感濕邪
records.common_causes_en: Spleen deficiency generating Dampness, dietary irregularity, chronic cough injuring the Lung, external Damp invasion
records.progression_zh: 痰濕鬱久可化熱,轉為痰熱壅肺;反覆發作可致肺脾兩虛。
records.progression_en: Long-stagnant Phlegm-Damp may transform into heat, shifting toward Phlegm-Heat Obstructing the Lung; recurrent episodes can lead to combined Lung-Spleen deficiency.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 痰濕阻肺痰白清稀量多、苔白膩、脈滑,偏寒濕;痰熱壅肺痰黃稠、苔黃膩、脈滑數,兼見發熱、胸痛,偏熱。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Phlegm-Damp Obstructing the Lung is a cold-damp pattern with thin white copious sputum and a white greasy coating; Phlegm-Heat Obstructing the Lung is a heat pattern with thick yellow sputum, a yellow greasy coating, fever, and chest pain.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 痰濕苔白膩;痰熱苔黃膩
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear heat, transform phlegm, calm wheezing
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with yellow, greasy coating
records.mechanism_zh: 痰濁鬱久化熱,或外感熱邪與痰互結,壅塞肺絡,肺失清肅,故見咳嗽氣粗、痰黃稠、胸痛;熱盛傷津,故發熱口渴。
records.mechanism_en: Phlegm stagnating and transforming into heat, or external heat combining with Phlegm, obstructs the Lung collaterals and impairs its clearing/descending function — producing a coarse cough, thick yellow sputum, and chest pain, with fever and thirst from heat consuming fluids.
records.common_causes_zh: 痰濕鬱久化熱、外感風熱與痰互結、素體痰盛復感熱邪
records.common_causes_en: Phlegm-Damp stagnating and transforming into heat, external Wind-Heat combining with Phlegm, constitutional Phlegm excess combined with heat invasion
records.progression_zh: 多由痰濕阻肺化熱,或風熱犯肺傳裡而成;熱毒熾盛可致肺癰(肺膿瘍)。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Phlegm-Damp Obstructing the Lung transforming into heat, or Wind-Heat Invading the Lung penetrating deeper; intense heat-toxin can progress to Lung Abscess.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 痰熱壅肺痰黃稠、苔黃膩、脈滑數,兼發熱胸痛,屬熱;痰濕阻肺痰白清稀、苔白膩、脈滑,屬寒濕。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Phlegm-Heat Obstructing the Lung shows thick yellow sputum with fever and chest pain — a heat pattern; Phlegm-Damp Obstructing the Lung shows thin white sputum — a cold-damp pattern.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 痰熱壅肺為熱邪入裡之裡熱證,痰黃稠量多、胸痛喘促;風熱犯肺為表證初起,病位較淺,無明顯胸痛。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Phlegm-Heat Obstructing the Lung is an interior heat pattern with copious thick sputum and chest pain; Wind-Heat Invading the Lung is an early exterior pattern without chest pain.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Tonify Spleen Qi, harmonize Stomach, assist transportation
records.short_summary_zh: 脾氣虛弱，運化水谷失職。以食少腹脹、飯後尤甚、大便溏薄、神疲乏力、肢體倦怠、面色萎黃為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Weakness of Spleen Qi impairing transportation and transformation of food and water. Characterized by poor appetite, postprandial abdominal distension, loose stools, fatigue, and sallow complexion.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 消化系本虛病機：食少、腹脹、便溏、氣虛為四大診斷要點。為多數脾胃病與氣血生化不足之根本。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Digestive Root Deficiency: Key indicators are poor appetite, bloating, loose stools, and tiredness. Root cause of fluid/blood deficiency.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr Spleen Pathology & NCCAOM 考點：代表方四君子湯 (Si Jun Zi Tang) 或參苓白朮散。主穴：ST36 足三里、SP6 三陰交、RN12 中脘、BL20 脾俞。
records.tongue_zh: 舌質淡胖，邊有齒痕，苔薄白（另作：舌淡苔白，或有齒痕）
records.tongue_en: Pale swollen tongue with teethmarks and thin white coating

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 脾氣虛以食少、腹脹、便溏為主;中氣下陷在此基礎上兼見臟器下垂或墜脹感,是脾氣虛的進一步發展。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Spleen Qi Deficiency centers on poor appetite, bloating and loose stools; Central Qi Sinking additionally shows organ prolapse or a sinking sensation, representing a further stage.
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 脾氣虛脈緩弱;中氣下陷脈濡細

records.mechanism_en: Weak Spleen Qi impairs the transportation and transformation of food and fluids, leading to poor appetite, postprandial distension, loose stools, and fatigue.
records.progression_zh: 脾氣虛可使水濕停聚而生濕痰，亦可進一步發展為脾陽虛、中氣下陷或脾不統血。

records.treatment_principle_en: Warm the middle, fortify the spleen
key_signs_en: Abdominal pain relieved by warmth and pressure
supporting_signs_en: Clear frequent urine or edema tendency
records.tongue_en: Pale, swollen tongue with a white, slippery coating
records.mechanism_zh: 脾陽虛衰,失於溫煦運化,寒從中生,故見脘腹冷痛喜溫、四肢冷、完穀不化;陽虛水濕不化,可見水腫、尿清長。
records.mechanism_en: Spleen Yang deficiency loses its warming and transforming function, allowing internal cold to arise — producing cold epigastric pain relieved by warmth, cold limbs, and undigested food in loose stools; failure to transform fluids can cause edema.
records.common_causes_zh: 脾氣虛遷延、過食生冷、久病傷陽、命門火衰
records.common_causes_en: Prolonged Spleen Qi Deficiency, excessive raw/cold food, chronic illness injuring Yang, decline of Life Gate Fire
records.progression_zh: 多由脾氣虛發展而來;陽虛及腎,可發展為脾腎陽虛。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Spleen Qi Deficiency; if it extends to the Kidney it can progress to Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 脾陽虛在脾氣虛基礎上兼見明顯寒象(冷痛喜溫、四肢冷);脾氣虛無寒象。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Spleen Yang Deficiency adds overt cold signs to the Spleen Qi Deficiency picture; Spleen Qi Deficiency alone lacks cold signs.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 脾陽虛病位局限於脾;脾腎陽虛兼見腰膝冷痛痠軟、五更瀉等腎陽虛表現,程度更重。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Spleen Yang Deficiency is centered on the Spleen; Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency additionally shows Kidney Yang signs such as cold low-back pain and early-morning diarrhea, and is more severe.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Tonify middle qi, raise the sunken
key_signs_en: Distending, sinking sensation in the epigastrium/abdomen
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with white coating
records.mechanism_zh: 脾氣虛極,升清無力,清陽不升反陷,固攝失職,故見臟器下垂(胃、子宮、脫肛等)或下墜感;脾虛失運,故食少便溏。
records.mechanism_en: Extreme Spleen Qi deficiency loses its power to raise clear Yang; clear Yang sinks instead of rising, and the Spleen's holding function fails — producing organ prolapse (stomach, uterus, rectum) or a sinking sensation, along with poor appetite and loose stools from impaired transformation.
records.common_causes_zh: 脾氣虛遷延不癒、勞倦傷脾、產後失於調養、久瀉久痢
records.common_causes_en: Untreated/prolonged Spleen Qi Deficiency, overexertion, inadequate postpartum recovery, chronic diarrhea/dysentery
records.progression_zh: 多由脾氣虛發展而來;氣虛及陽,可進一步發展為脾陽虛。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Spleen Qi Deficiency; if Qi deficiency extends to Yang it can progress to Spleen Yang Deficiency.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 中氣下陷以臟器下垂或下墜感為特徵性表現;脾氣虛無此下陷之象。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Central Qi Sinking is distinguished by organ prolapse or a sinking sensation, which plain Spleen Qi Deficiency lacks.

records.treatment_principle_en: Fortify the spleen, boost qi to contain blood
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 脾氣虛弱,統攝血液功能失職,血不循經而外溢,故見各種慢性反覆出血(崩漏、便血、尿血、紫斑等),血色淡質稀,兼見脾氣虛之食少便溏、倦怠等症。
records.mechanism_en: Spleen Qi deficiency impairs the Spleen's function of holding Blood within the vessels, allowing Blood to escape outside its normal pathways — producing chronic, recurrent, pale-and-thin bleeding (uterine bleeding, blood in stool/urine, purpura) alongside the underlying Spleen Qi deficiency signs.
records.common_causes_zh: 脾氣虛日久、勞倦傷脾、飲食失調、思慮過度
records.common_causes_en: Prolonged Spleen Qi Deficiency, overexertion, dietary irregularity, excessive mental strain
records.progression_zh: 多由脾氣虛發展而來;失血日久可致血虛,甚則氣隨血脫。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Spleen Qi Deficiency; prolonged blood loss can produce Blood Deficiency and, in severe cases, Qi collapsing with Blood loss.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 脾不統血在脾氣虛基礎上以慢性反覆出血為特徵性表現;脾氣虛本身無出血傾向。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Spleen Not Governing Blood is distinguished from plain Spleen Qi Deficiency by its characteristic chronic recurrent bleeding.

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear heat, transform damp
key_signs_en: Bitter, sticky taste in the mouth
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with yellow, greasy coating
records.mechanism_zh: 濕熱蘊結脾胃,運化與受納失職,氣機壅滯,故見脘腹痞悶、口苦口黏、身重;濕熱下注腸道,故大便黏滯不爽。
records.mechanism_en: Damp-Heat accumulates in the Spleen and Stomach, impairing transportation and reception — producing epigastric oppression, a bitter sticky taste, and body heaviness; Damp-Heat descending to the intestines produces sticky, unsatisfying stools.
records.common_causes_zh: 嗜食肥甘厚膩、外感濕熱之邪、脾虛濕停日久化熱
records.common_causes_en: Excessive rich/greasy food, external Damp-Heat invasion, chronic Spleen-deficiency Dampness transforming into heat
records.progression_zh: 濕熱鬱久可致黃疸;下注可與下焦濕熱或肝膽濕熱並見。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Damp-Heat can cause jaundice; it may descend and coexist with Lower-Burner or Liver-Gallbladder Damp-Heat.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 脾胃濕熱苔黃膩、脈濡數,屬濕熱;寒濕困脾苔白膩、脈濡緩,口淡不渴,屬寒濕。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Damp-Heat in Spleen-Stomach shows a yellow greasy coating and rapid pulse; Cold-Damp Encumbering the Spleen shows a white greasy coating, a moderate pulse, and a bland mouth.

records.treatment_principle_en: Warm the middle, dispel cold-damp
key_signs_en: Heaviness of the head and body
records.tongue_en: Pale, swollen tongue with white, greasy coating
records.mechanism_zh: 寒濕內盛,困阻脾陽,運化失職,清陽不升,故見脘腹脹悶、口淡不渴、頭身困重、便溏。
records.mechanism_en: Internal Cold-Damp encumbers Spleen Yang and impairs transportation, preventing clear Yang from rising — producing epigastric fullness, a bland mouth without thirst, heaviness of the head and body, and loose stools.
records.common_causes_zh: 外感寒濕之邪、久居潮濕之地、過食生冷
records.common_causes_en: External Cold-Damp invasion, prolonged residence in damp environments, excessive raw/cold food
records.progression_zh: 寒濕困脾日久傷陽,可發展為脾陽虛;濕邪鬱久可化熱,轉為脾胃濕熱。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Cold-Damp encumbrance can injure Yang, progressing to Spleen Yang Deficiency; stagnant Dampness may transform into heat, shifting toward Damp-Heat in Spleen-Stomach.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 寒濕困脾口淡不渴、苔白膩,屬寒濕;脾胃濕熱口苦口黏、苔黃膩,屬濕熱。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Cold-Damp Encumbering the Spleen shows a bland mouth and white greasy coating; Damp-Heat in Spleen-Stomach shows a bitter sticky taste and yellow greasy coating.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 寒濕困脾以身重困倦、苔白膩等濕邪為主,屬實證或虛實夾雜;脾陽虛以脘腹冷痛喜溫、四肢冷等虛寒為主,屬純虛證。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Cold-Damp Encumbering the Spleen centers on Dampness signs and is excess or mixed; Spleen Yang Deficiency centers on deficiency-cold signs (pain relieved by warmth, cold limbs) and is a pure deficiency pattern.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear stomach fire
supporting_signs_en: Thirst with preference for cold drinks
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with yellow coating
records.mechanism_zh: 胃熱熾盛,腐熟太過,故消穀善飢;熱盛傷絡,循經上炎於齒齦,故牙齦腫痛;熱盛傷津,故口臭便秘。
records.mechanism_en: Intense Stomach Heat accelerates the 'rotting and ripening' of food, causing excessive hunger; the heat rises along the channel to the gums producing swelling and pain, while consuming fluids produces foul breath and constipation.
records.common_causes_zh: 嗜食辛辣肥甘、情志化火犯胃、外感熱邪傳裡
records.common_causes_en: Excessive spicy/rich food, emotional fire invading the Stomach, external heat transmitted to the interior
records.progression_zh: 胃熱日久傷陰,可發展為胃陰虛;熱盛動血可致齒衄或吐血。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Stomach Heat can consume Yin, progressing to Stomach Yin Deficiency; severe heat can force Blood to move recklessly, causing gum bleeding or hematemesis.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 胃熱熾盛為實熱證,消穀善飢、苔黃、脈滑數有力;胃陰虛為虛熱證,飢不欲食、舌紅少苔、脈細數。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Stomach Heat is an excess-heat pattern with excessive hunger and a forceful rapid pulse; Stomach Yin Deficiency is a deficiency-heat pattern with hunger but no desire to eat and a thready rapid pulse.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 胃熱熾盛以消穀善飢、牙齦腫痛等單純熱象為主;肝膽濕熱兼見口苦、身目發黃等濕邪表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Stomach Heat presents pure heat signs; Liver-Gallbladder Damp-Heat additionally shows Dampness signs such as bitter taste and jaundice.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: AcuTing 刻意保留兩個獨立正典節點：胃熱熾盛為較廣泛/較輕的胃熱概念；胃火熾盛為更強烈的火熱階段（消穀善飢、牙齦腫痛出血、便秘更著、脈洪大有力）。部分外部來源將兩者視為同一證型，此分歧予以保留。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: AcuTing deliberately keeps two separate canonical nodes: Stomach Heat is the broader, less intense concept; Stomach Fire Blazing is the more intense Fire-stage manifestation (stronger hunger, gum swelling/bleeding, more pronounced constipation, a bigger more forceful pulse). Some external sources treat these as one Pattern — that disagreement is preserved.

records.treatment_principle_en: Nourish stomach yin
supporting_signs_en: Dry retching or hiccups may occur
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with little, dry coating
records.mechanism_zh: 胃陰不足,失於濡潤和降,虛熱內生,故見胃脘隱痛、飢不欲食、口乾咽燥;腸道失潤,故大便乾結。
records.mechanism_en: Stomach Yin deficiency loses its moistening and descending function, allowing deficiency heat to arise internally — producing dull epigastric pain, hunger without appetite, and dry mouth/throat, with dry intestines producing bound stools.
records.common_causes_zh: 熱病後期傷津、久病傷陰、過食辛燥、情志化火
records.common_causes_en: Late-stage febrile disease consuming fluids, chronic illness injuring Yin, excessive spicy/drying food, emotional fire
records.progression_zh: 多由胃熱傷陰或久病傷陰發展而來;胃陰虛日久可累及脾氣,形成氣陰兩虛。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Stomach Heat or chronic illness injuring Yin; prolonged Stomach Yin Deficiency can involve Spleen Qi, forming combined Qi-Yin deficiency.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 胃陰虛為虛熱證,飢不欲食、舌紅少苔;胃熱熾盛為實熱證,消穀善飢、苔黃厚。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Stomach Yin Deficiency is a deficiency-heat pattern with hunger but no desire to eat; Stomach Heat is an excess-heat pattern with excessive hunger and a thick yellow coating.

records.treatment_principle_en: Reduce food stagnation, guide out accumulation
key_signs_en: Foul, rotten-food belching and acid regurgitation
supporting_signs_en: Dislike of pressure on the abdomen
Vomiting after eating with relief after vomiting
records.tongue_en: Thick, greasy tongue coating
records.mechanism_zh: 飲食不節,暴飲暴食,損傷脾胃,食滯中焦,運化失職,氣機壅滯,故見脘腹脹滿、噯腐吞酸、厭食。
records.mechanism_en: Dietary irregularity or overeating injures the Spleen and Stomach, causing food to stagnate in the Middle Burner and obstructing Qi movement — producing fullness, foul belching, acid regurgitation, and aversion to food.
records.common_causes_zh: 暴飲暴食、飲食不節、脾胃素虛運化無力
records.common_causes_en: Overeating, dietary irregularity, underlying Spleen-Stomach weakness with impaired transportation
records.progression_zh: 食積日久可化熱,或損傷脾胃形成脾胃虛弱;反覆食積可致小兒疳積。
records.progression_en: Prolonged food stagnation can transform into heat, or injure the Spleen-Stomach leading to Spleen-Stomach weakness; recurrent episodes in children can lead to infantile malnutrition patterns.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 食滯胃脘以噯腐吞酸、拒按、便酸臭為特徵,病因在飲食;寒濕困脾以身重困倦、口淡不渴為主,病因在濕邪。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Food Stagnation is distinguished by foul belching and dislike of pressure, caused by diet; Cold-Damp Encumbering the Spleen centers on heaviness and a bland mouth, caused by Dampness.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Course the liver, resolve depression, regulate qi
key_signs_en: Sensation of a lump in the throat
records.tongue_en: Thin white tongue coating
records.mechanism_zh: 情志不遂,肝失疏泄,氣機鬱滯,故見脅肋脹痛、胸悶太息;肝氣鬱結,循經上逆或橫逆犯胃犯脾,亦可影響沖任而致月經不調。
records.mechanism_en: Unresolved emotional stress impairs the Liver's function of ensuring the free flow of Qi, causing Qi stagnation — producing hypochondriac distention, chest oppression, and frequent sighing; the stagnant Qi may also invade the Stomach/Spleen or disturb the Chong-Ren vessels, causing menstrual irregularity.
records.common_causes_zh: 情志不遂、抑鬱惱怒、長期精神緊張
records.common_causes_en: Unresolved emotional stress, suppressed anger, prolonged psychological tension
records.progression_zh: 肝氣鬱結日久化火,可發展為肝火上炎;橫逆犯脾胃,可致肝脾不和或肝胃不和;氣滯日久可致血瘀。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Liver Qi Stagnation can transform into Liver Fire; if it invades the Spleen/Stomach it produces Liver-Spleen or Liver-Stomach Disharmony; prolonged Qi stagnation can also lead to Blood Stasis.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝氣鬱結以情志抑鬱、脅肋脹痛、脈弦為主,無熱象;肝火上炎兼見頭痛目赤、口苦、舌紅苔黃、脈弦數等實熱表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Qi Stagnation shows depression and hypochondriac distention with a wiry pulse and no heat signs; Liver Fire adds excess-heat signs such as headache, red eyes, and a rapid wiry pulse.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝氣鬱結病位偏肝;肝脾不和兼見腹脹腹痛、腸鳴便溏等脾虛/脾受克表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Qi Stagnation is centered on the Liver; Liver-Spleen Disharmony additionally shows Spleen signs such as abdominal distention and loose stools.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear liver fire
supporting_signs_en: Splitting headache with a tight neck/upper back
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with yellow coating
records.mechanism_zh: 肝氣鬱結日久化火,或情志過極,肝火循經上炎,擾及頭目清竅,故見頭痛目赤、耳鳴如潮;肝火犯及膽經,故口苦;熱盛傷津,故便秘尿黃。
records.mechanism_en: Prolonged Liver Qi Stagnation transforming into Fire, or extreme emotional stress, causes Liver Fire to flare upward along its channel and disturb the head and eyes, producing headache, red eyes, and roaring tinnitus; heat injuring fluids produces constipation and dark urine.
records.common_causes_zh: 肝氣鬱結化火、情志過極(大怒)、嗜食辛辣助火
records.common_causes_en: Liver Qi Stagnation transforming into Fire, extreme emotional stress (rage), excessive spicy food fueling fire
records.progression_zh: 肝火可犯肺(肝火犯肺,乾咳);熱盛傷陰,可轉為肝陽上亢或肝腎陰虛;熱極動風,可致肝風內動。
records.progression_en: Liver Fire may scorch the Lung; if heat consumes Yin it can shift toward Liver Yang Rising or Liver-Kidney Yin Deficiency; extreme heat can stir internal Wind.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝火上炎為純實熱證,起病急,舌紅苔黃、脈弦數有力,無下焦虛象;肝陽上亢為本虛標實,兼見腰膝痠軟等肝腎陰虛表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Fire is a pure excess-heat pattern with no lower-body deficiency; Liver Yang Rising is root-deficiency-branch-excess, adding Liver-Kidney Yin deficiency signs like sore knees and low back.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝火上炎以頭面炎上之熱象為主(頭痛目赤);肝膽濕熱兼見苔黃膩、身目發黃、陰部濕癢等濕邪表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Fire presents heat rising to the head (headache, red eyes); Liver-Gallbladder Damp-Heat additionally shows Dampness signs such as a greasy yellow coating and jaundice.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Calm the liver, subdue yang, nourish liver-kidney
records.short_summary_zh: 肝腎陰虛於下，水不涵木，致使肝陽偏亢、上擾清空。以頭痛眩暈、急躁易怒、面紅目赤、腰膝痠軟為主要臨床特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Liver and Kidney Yin deficiency below failing to nourish Wood, allowing Liver Yang to become hyperactive and surge upward to disturb the head. Characterized by throbbing headache, dizziness, irritability, facial redness, and lumbar/knee weakness.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 本虛標實（上實下虛）：上焦呈現陽亢熱象（頭痛、眩暈、面紅目赤、急躁），下焦伴隨陰虛不足（腰膝痠軟、足脛無力）。多由情志所傷或久病傷陰引發。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Root Deficiency with Branch Excess (Upper Excess, Lower Deficiency): Upper body shows Yang hyperactivity (headache, dizziness, facial redness), while lower body exhibits Yin deficiency (weak knees/lumbar). Often triggered by emotional stress or chronic Yin depletion.
records.tongue_zh: 舌紅，苔少或薄黃（另作：舌紅少津）
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with scanty or thin yellow coating
records.pulse_en: Wiry and forceful pulse, or wiry, fine and rapid
key_signs_en: Sore, weak low back and knees
records.mechanism_zh: 肝腎陰血不足於下，不能涵養肝木與制約肝陽，肝陽遂上亢而擾及頭目，形成上實下虛。
records.mechanism_en: Deficient Liver-Kidney Yin or Blood below fails to nourish Wood and restrain Liver Yang, allowing Yang to rise and disturb the head in an upper-excess, lower-deficiency configuration.
records.common_causes_zh: 情志所傷；久病耗傷肝腎陰血。
records.common_causes_en: Emotional strain; chronic illness depleting Liver-Kidney Yin or Blood.

records.treatment_principle_en: Calm the liver, extinguish wind
key_signs_en: Dizziness with a sensation of imminent collapse
Slurred speech, in severe cases sudden collapse and coma
records.tongue_en: Red tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 肝陽亢逆化風,或熱極生風、血虛生風,風性主動,擾動筋脈清竅,故見眩暈欲仆、肢體震顫抽搐,甚則卒然昏仆、言語不利。
records.mechanism_en: Hyperactive Liver Yang transforming into Wind (or extreme heat / Blood deficiency generating Wind) causes the characteristically mobile nature of Wind to disturb the sinews and clear orifices, producing severe dizziness, tremor, convulsions, and in severe cases sudden collapse with slurred speech.
records.common_causes_zh: 肝陽上亢日久、熱邪熾盛、久病血虛筋脈失養、情志過激
records.common_causes_en: Prolonged Liver Yang Rising, intense heat, chronic Blood deficiency failing to nourish the sinews, extreme emotional stress
records.progression_zh: 多由肝陽上亢或肝腎陰虛發展而來;風痰上蒙清竅可致中風閉證,為急重症。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Liver Yang Rising or Liver-Kidney Yin Deficiency; Wind-Phlegm obstructing the orifices can precipitate a Wind-stroke closed pattern — a critical emergency.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝風內動以震顫抽搐、言語不利等「動」象為特徵性表現;肝陽上亢以眩暈頭脹、面紅為主,無明顯動風之象。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Wind is distinguished by characteristic Wind signs — tremor, convulsion, dysarthria; Liver Yang Rising shows dizziness and facial flushing without overt Wind movement.

records.treatment_principle_en: Nourish blood, supplement the liver
supporting_signs_en: Dry eyes, spots before the eyes
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 肝藏血,血虛則肝失所養,不能上榮頭目、濡養筋脈與爪甲,故見眩暈視物模糊、肢體麻木、爪甲不榮;沖任失於血養,故月經量少色淡。
records.mechanism_en: The Liver stores Blood; when Blood is deficient the Liver loses nourishment and fails to reach the eyes and sinews — producing dizziness, blurred vision, limb numbness, and lusterless nails, while the Chong-Ren vessels lacking Blood produce scanty, pale menses.
records.common_causes_zh: 脾虛生血不足、失血過多、久病耗血、思慮過度
records.common_causes_en: Spleen deficiency impairing Blood production, excessive blood loss, chronic illness consuming Blood, excessive mental strain
records.progression_zh: 血虛日久可累及陰,發展為肝陰虛;血不養筋日久可致虛風內動。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Blood deficiency can involve Yin, progressing to Liver Yin Deficiency; sinews deprived of Blood over time can generate deficiency Wind.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝血虛以眩暈、視物模糊、面色唇淡為主,無熱象;肝陰虛兼見五心煩熱、舌紅少苔等虛熱表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Blood Deficiency shows dizziness and pallor without heat signs; Liver Yin Deficiency additionally shows deficiency-heat signs such as five-center heat and a red tongue with little coating.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝血虛以麻木為主,無震顫抽搐;血虛日久筋脈失養,可進一步發展為虛風內動(震顫)。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Blood Deficiency shows numbness without tremor; if prolonged it can progress to deficiency-type internal Wind with tremor.

records.treatment_principle_en: Enrich yin, nourish the liver
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with little coating
records.mechanism_zh: 肝陰不足,不能濡養頭目筋脈,虛熱內生,故見兩目乾澀、脅肋隱痛、眩暈;陰虛生內熱,故五心煩熱。
records.mechanism_en: Liver Yin deficiency fails to moisten the eyes and sinews, allowing deficiency heat to arise internally — producing dry gritty eyes, dull hypochondriac pain, dizziness, and five-center heat.
records.common_causes_zh: 肝血虛日久傷陰、久病傷陰、熱病後期傷津、情志化火暗耗肝陰
records.common_causes_en: Prolonged Liver Blood deficiency injuring Yin, chronic illness, late-stage febrile disease consuming fluids, emotional fire quietly consuming Liver Yin
records.progression_zh: 肝陰虛日久,水不涵木,可發展為肝陽上亢;下汲腎陰,可致肝腎陰虛。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Liver Yin Deficiency can fail to restrain Liver Yang, progressing to Liver Yang Rising; if it draws on Kidney Yin it can lead to Liver-Kidney Yin Deficiency.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝陰虛見五心煩熱、舌紅少苔等虛熱之象;肝血虛以面色唇淡、無熱象為主。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Yin Deficiency shows deficiency-heat signs; Liver Blood Deficiency shows pallor without heat signs.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝陰虛病位局限於肝,無明顯陽亢上擾之象;肝陽上亢在肝腎陰虛基礎上兼見頭目脹痛、面紅等陽亢表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver Yin Deficiency alone lacks overt Yang-rising signs; Liver Yang Rising adds distending headache and facial flushing on top of the underlying Yin deficiency.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.name_en: Cold Stagnating in the Liver Channel
key_signs_zh: 少腹牽引睪丸墜脹冷痛
records.treatment_principle_en: Warm the liver, dispel cold, move qi
key_signs_en: Cold, distending, dragging pain in the lower abdomen radiating to the testicle
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with white, greasy coating
records.pulse_en: Deep, wiry pulse, or slow, or deep-tight
records.mechanism_zh: 寒邪侵襲肝經,凝滯氣血,肝脈循少腹絡陰器,故見少腹牽引睪丸墜脹冷痛,得溫則減、遇寒加重。
records.mechanism_en: Cold pathogen invades the Liver channel and congeals Qi and Blood; since the Liver channel traverses the lower abdomen and genitals, this produces cold, distending, dragging testicular/lower-abdominal pain that is relieved by warmth and aggravated by cold.
records.common_causes_zh: 感受寒邪、久居寒濕之地、過食生冷
records.common_causes_en: Exposure to Cold pathogen, prolonged residence in cold-damp environments, excessive raw/cold food
records.progression_zh: 寒邪鬱久可化熱;素體陽虛者易反覆發作。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Cold stagnation may transform into heat; those with underlying Yang deficiency are prone to recurrence.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 寒滯肝脈以少腹睪丸冷痛、得溫則減為特徵,屬寒實證;肝氣鬱結以情志抑鬱、脅肋脹痛為主,無明顯寒象。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Cold Stagnation in the Liver Channel is a cold-excess pattern with cold testicular/lower-abdominal pain relieved by warmth; Liver Qi Stagnation centers on emotional depression and hypochondriac distention without cold signs.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear and drain liver-gallbladder damp-heat
key_signs_en: Yellowing of the body and eyes
Genital dampness/itching or foul yellow discharge
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with yellow, greasy coating
records.pulse_en: Wiry, rapid or slippery, rapid pulse
records.mechanism_zh: 濕熱蘊結肝膽,疏泄失常,故脅肋脹痛、口苦;膽汁不循常道,外溢肌膚,故身目發黃;濕熱下注,循肝經至陰部,故見帶下黃臭、陰部濕癢。
records.mechanism_en: Damp-Heat accumulates in the Liver and Gallbladder, impairing the free flow of Qi and bile — producing hypochondriac pain, bitter taste, and jaundice when bile overflows to the skin; Damp-Heat descending along the Liver channel to the genitals produces foul yellow discharge and itching.
records.common_causes_zh: 嗜食肥甘厚膩、外感濕熱之邪、情志不遂化火夾濕
records.common_causes_en: Excessive rich/greasy food, external Damp-Heat invasion, emotional stress transforming into fire combined with Dampness
records.progression_zh: 濕熱鬱久可致黃疸加重或積聚(癥瘕);濕熱下注日久可致帶下病、陰癢反覆。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Damp-Heat can worsen jaundice or form abdominal masses; prolonged lower-burner involvement can cause recurrent vaginal discharge/itching.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝膽濕熱兼見苔黃膩、身目發黃等濕邪表現;肝火上炎以頭面炎上之熱象(頭痛目赤)為主,無濕象。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver-Gallbladder Damp-Heat shows Dampness signs (greasy coating, jaundice); Liver Fire shows pure heat rising to the head without Dampness.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝膽濕熱病位偏上中焦(脅肋、口苦、黃疸);下焦濕熱病位偏下焦(尿頻尿痛、帶下),二者可同時並見。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver-Gallbladder Damp-Heat is centered on the upper/middle burner (hypochondrium, jaundice); Lower-Burner Damp-Heat is centered on the lower burner (urinary/genital signs) — the two may coexist.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Tonify heart qi
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue, may be swollen
records.mechanism_zh: 心主血脈、藏神,賴心氣鼓動血行。久病失養、年高臟氣漸衰或稟賦不足,致心氣虛弱,推動無力,血行遲緩,心神失養,故見心悸、氣短、活動後加重。
records.mechanism_en: The Heart governs Blood vessels and houses the Shen, relying on Heart Qi to propel Blood flow. Chronic illness, advancing age, or congenital weakness can deplete Heart Qi, weakening its propelling force and depriving the Shen of nourishment.
records.common_causes_zh: 久病失養、年老體衰、稟賦不足、勞倦傷氣
records.common_causes_en: Chronic illness, old age, congenital weakness, overexertion depleting Qi
records.progression_zh: 心氣虛日久不復,陽氣漸衰,可發展為心陽虛;亦可與肺氣虛互見(心肺氣虛)。
records.progression_en: If Heart Qi Deficiency persists, Yang may also become deficient, progressing to Heart Yang Deficiency; it may also co-occur with Lung Qi Deficiency.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心氣虛以氣短、自汗、活動後加重為主,無明顯寒象；心陽虛進一步見畏寒肢冷、面色晄白。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Qi Deficiency shows exertional dyspnea and sweating without cold signs; Heart Yang Deficiency adds cold limbs and a pale-bright complexion.
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 氣虛脈虛;陽虛脈弱或結代
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心氣虛以氣短乏力、自汗為主;心血虛以失眠多夢、健忘、眩暈等神失所養表現為主,少見自汗。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Qi Deficiency centers on exertional breathlessness and sweating; Heart Blood Deficiency centers on insomnia, poor memory, and dizziness from an undernourished Shen.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 氣虛舌淡;血虛舌淡而少華
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Warm and supplement heart yang
records.tongue_en: Pale, swollen tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 心陽為心氣之進一步虛衰,失於溫煦鼓動,陽虛則寒象顯,血脈失於溫運,故見胸悶或痛、畏寒肢冷、面色晄白;心陽不振,水氣亦可上凌心。
records.mechanism_en: Heart Yang Deficiency is a deepening of Heart Qi Deficiency in which Yang's warming and propelling function fails; without Yang's warmth cold signs emerge and Blood flow slows, producing chest oppression, cold limbs, and a pale-bright complexion.
records.common_causes_zh: 心氣虛遷延不癒、稟賦陽虛、久病傷陽、寒邪直中
records.common_causes_en: Untreated/prolonged Heart Qi Deficiency, constitutional Yang weakness, chronic illness injuring Yang, direct Cold invasion
records.progression_zh: 心陽虛進一步發展,陽氣暴脫可致心陽暴脫(厥脫)重證;水飲內停可見水氣凌心。
records.progression_en: Severe progression can lead to Heart Yang collapse (a critical pattern); internal fluid accumulation may present as fluids attacking the Heart.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心陽虛在心氣虛基礎上兼見明顯寒象(畏寒肢冷、面色晄白),心氣虛則無寒象。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Yang Deficiency adds overt cold signs (cold limbs, pale-bright face) to the Heart Qi Deficiency picture; Heart Qi Deficiency alone lacks cold signs.
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 陽虛脈弱或結代;氣虛脈虛
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心陽虛以虛冷、氣短、脈弱為主;心血瘀阻以刺痛固定、舌暗瘀斑、脈澀為主,二者常相互轉化(陽虛可致血行遲滯而生瘀)。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Yang Deficiency is a deficiency-cold pattern (weak pulse, cold limbs); Heart Blood Stasis is marked by fixed stabbing pain and a dusky tongue with a choppy pulse — the two often coexist or transform into each other.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 陽虛舌淡胖;血瘀舌暗或有瘀斑
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 陽虛脈弱;血瘀脈澀或結代

records.treatment_principle_en: Nourish blood, calm the spirit
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 心主血,血虛則心失所養,神不安舍,故見心悸、失眠多夢、健忘、易驚;血虛不能上榮頭面,故面色唇色淡白、眩暈。
records.mechanism_en: The Heart governs Blood; when Blood is deficient the Heart and Shen lose nourishment, producing palpitations, dream-disturbed insomnia, poor memory and easy startling, while the face and lips lose their normal color and dizziness may occur.
records.common_causes_zh: 脾虛生血不足、失血過多、久病耗血、思慮過度暗耗心血
records.common_causes_en: Spleen deficiency impairing Blood production, excessive blood loss, chronic illness consuming Blood, excessive mental strain quietly consuming Heart Blood
records.progression_zh: 心血虛常與脾氣虛並見,發展為心脾兩虛;血虛日久可兼陰虛。
records.progression_en: Heart Blood Deficiency commonly co-occurs with Spleen Qi Deficiency, progressing to Heart-Spleen Deficiency; prolonged Blood deficiency may also involve Yin.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心血虛以面色唇淡、頭暈為主,無明顯熱象;心陰虛兼見五心煩熱、盜汗、舌紅少苔等虛熱表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Blood Deficiency shows pallor and dizziness without heat signs; Heart Yin Deficiency additionally shows deficiency-heat signs such as five-center heat, night sweats, and a red tongue with little coating.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 血虛舌淡;陰虛舌紅少苔
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 血虛脈細弱;陰虛脈細數
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心血虛病位偏心;心脾兩虛兼見食少、便溏、倦怠等脾氣虛表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Blood Deficiency is centered on the Heart; Heart-Spleen Deficiency additionally shows Spleen Qi signs such as poor appetite, loose stools, and fatigue.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 血虛舌淡;心脾兩虛舌淡苔薄白

records.treatment_principle_en: Enrich yin, nourish the heart, calm the spirit
records.tongue_en: Red, dry tongue with little or no coating
records.mechanism_zh: 心陰不足,不能濡養心神、制約心陽,虛熱內生,故見心悸心煩、失眠、五心煩熱、盜汗;陰虛津液不能上潮,故口乾咽燥。
records.mechanism_en: Heart Yin Deficiency leaves the Shen without nourishment and unable to restrain Heart Yang, allowing deficiency heat to arise internally — producing palpitations with vexation, insomnia, five-center heat, and night sweats, with dryness from insufficient fluid.
records.common_causes_zh: 久病傷陰、熱病後期傷津、思慮過度暗耗心陰、稟賦陰虛
records.common_causes_en: Chronic illness injuring Yin, late-stage febrile disease consuming fluids, excessive mental strain, constitutional Yin weakness
records.progression_zh: 心陰虛日久,虛火上炎可致心火亢盛;若下汲腎陰,可發展為心腎不交/心腎陰虛。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Heart Yin Deficiency can allow deficiency fire to flare as Heart Fire; if it draws on Kidney Yin it may progress to Heart-Kidney Not Communicating.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心陰虛見五心煩熱、盜汗、舌紅少苔等虛熱之象;心血虛以面色唇淡、無熱象為主。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Yin Deficiency shows deficiency-heat signs (five-center heat, night sweats, red tongue); Heart Blood Deficiency shows pallor without heat signs.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 陰虛舌紅少苔;血虛舌淡
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 陰虛脈細數;血虛脈細弱

differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Yin Deficiency is limited to the Heart; Heart-Kidney Not Communicating additionally shows Kidney Yin deficiency signs such as low-back soreness and tinnitus, with more pronounced deficiency fire.

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear heart fire
records.tongue_en: Red tongue, redder tip, possible tip ulcers
records.mechanism_zh: 心火亢盛,火性炎上,擾動心神,故見心煩失眠、口舌生瘡;火熱下移小腸,故小便短赤,甚則尿血。
records.mechanism_en: Heart Fire blazes upward and disturbs the Shen, producing vexation, insomnia, and mouth/tongue ulcers; when the fire moves down to the Small Intestine it produces scant, dark, burning urination.
records.common_causes_zh: 情志化火、過食辛熱、外感熱邪內傳、心陰虛虛火上炎
records.common_causes_en: Emotional stress transforming into fire, excessive spicy/hot food, invasion of external heat, or deficiency fire from Heart Yin deficiency flaring upward
records.progression_zh: 心火可下移小腸致小腸實熱;熱盛動血可致吐血、衄血;久病傷陰可轉為陰虛火旺。
records.progression_en: Heart Fire may descend to the Small Intestine as repletion heat there; severe heat can force Blood to move recklessly (bleeding); prolonged fire can consume Yin and shift toward Yin-deficiency fire.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心火亢盛屬實熱,起病較急,舌紅絳、脈數有力;心陰虛屬虛熱,病程較久,五心煩熱、舌紅少苔、脈細數。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Fire is an excess-heat pattern with a forceful rapid pulse and deep-red tongue; Heart Yin Deficiency is a deficiency-heat pattern with five-center heat and a thready rapid pulse.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 心火舌尖紅絳;陰虛舌紅少苔
differential_patterns.pulse_difference_zh: 心火脈數有力;陰虛脈細數

records.treatment_principle_en: Invigorate blood, dispel stasis, unblock the vessels
records.tongue_en: Dusky tongue, possible static (purple/blue) spots
records.mechanism_zh: 心陽不振或氣滯,血行不暢,瘀阻心脈,不通則痛,故見心胸刺痛、痛處固定、痛引肩背內臂;瘀阻脈道,故唇甲青紫、舌暗有瘀斑。
records.mechanism_en: Failure of Heart Yang to move Blood, or Qi stagnation, leads to Blood Stasis obstructing the Heart vessels; obstruction causes fixed stabbing pain radiating to the shoulder and inner arm, with cyanotic lips/nails and a dusky, spotted tongue.
records.common_causes_zh: 心陽虛久病、情志失調氣滯、寒凝血脈、痰濁閉阻
records.common_causes_en: Chronic Heart Yang Deficiency, emotional stress causing Qi stagnation, Cold congealing the vessels, Phlegm obstruction
records.progression_zh: 多由心陽虛、氣滯久病發展而來;瘀阻甚者可致心陽暴脫等急重證。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from long-standing Heart Yang Deficiency or Qi stagnation; severe obstruction can precipitate acute critical patterns such as Heart Yang collapse.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心血瘀阻以刺痛固定、舌暗瘀斑、脈澀為特徵;心陽虛以畏寒肢冷、脈弱之虛寒象為主,二者常互為因果。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart Blood Stasis is marked by fixed stabbing pain and a dusky spotted tongue with a choppy pulse; Heart Yang Deficiency is a deficiency-cold pattern with cold limbs and a weak pulse — the two often cause each other.
differential_patterns.tongue_difference_zh: 血瘀舌暗瘀斑;陽虛舌淡胖

records.treatment_principle_en: Flush phlegm, open the portals
key_signs_en: Loss of consciousness/collapse in severe cases
records.tongue_en: Pink or pale, coating white and greasy
records.mechanism_zh: 痰濁內盛,蒙蔽心竅,清竅失靈,神明失主,故見神識痴呆、意識模糊,甚則昏不知人;痰阻氣道,故喉中痰鳴。
records.mechanism_en: Turbid Phlegm accumulates internally and mists the Heart orifices, clouding the Shen — producing mental dullness, impaired awareness, and in severe cases loss of consciousness, with a gurgling phlegm sound in the throat.
records.common_causes_zh: 情志失調、氣滯生痰、飲食不節聚濕成痰、素體痰盛
records.common_causes_en: Emotional disturbance generating Phlegm via Qi stagnation, dietary irregularity producing Damp-Phlegm, constitutional Phlegm excess
records.progression_zh: 痰濁久鬱化熱,可轉為痰火擾心;蒙竅甚者可致中風閉證。
records.progression_en: Long-stagnant Phlegm may transform into heat, shifting toward Phlegm-Fire Disturbing the Heart; severe orifice obstruction can present as the closed pattern of Wind-stroke.

records.treatment_principle_en: Warm and tonify Kidney Yang, replenish Gate of Vitality
records.short_summary_zh: 腎陽虧虛，命門火衰，溫煦失職。以腰膝酸冷、畏寒肢冷（下肢尤甚）、神疲乏力、小便清長夜尿多、陽痿或水腫為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Deficiency of Kidney Yang and decline of Gate of Vitality Fire. Characterized by cold soreness of lumbar/knees, aversion to cold with icy limbs, clear profuse nocturia, erectile dysfunction, or edema.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 腎系虛寒病機：腰膝酸冷、畏寒肢冷、夜尿多、脈沉細為四大診斷要點。與腎陰虛（熱象、手足心熱）明確對照。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Kidney Deficiency-Cold: Cold knees, aversion to cold, and nocturia are key diagnostic criteria. Clear contrast with Kidney Yin Deficiency.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr TCM Pathology & NCCAOM 考點：代表方金匱腎氣丸 (Jin Kui Shen Qi Wan) 或右歸丸。主藥附子、肉桂溫補命門之火。
records.tongue_en: Pale swollen tongue with white slippery coating
records.pulse_zh: 脈沉細無力，尺脈沉微（另作：脈沉遲無力，尺弱）
records.pulse_en: Deep, fine, and weak pulse, especially faint in Chi position

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 腎陽虛見畏寒肢冷、五更瀉等虛寒之象;腎陰虛見五心煩熱、盜汗等虛熱之象,二者為腎系陰陽兩端。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Kidney Yang Deficiency shows deficiency-cold signs (cold limbs, early-morning diarrhea); Kidney Yin Deficiency shows deficiency-heat signs (five-center heat, night sweats) — the two Yin/Yang poles of Kidney deficiency.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

key_signs_en: Cold, aching low back and knees
records.mechanism_zh: 腎陽虧虛、命門火衰，溫煦與氣化失職，故見腰膝酸冷、畏寒肢冷、清長夜尿或水液停聚。
records.mechanism_en: Deficient Kidney Yang and declining Ming Men Fire impair warming and Qi transformation, causing cold weak lumbar and knees, aversion to cold, clear profuse nocturia, or fluid retention.
records.progression_zh: 腎陽虛加重時可見水液泛濫，並可能進一步影響脾、心或肺的陽氣與氣化功能。
records.progression_en: As Kidney Yang Deficiency deepens, fluid overflow may appear and the warming or transforming functions of the Spleen, Heart, or Lung may also be affected.
supporting_signs_en: Clear profuse urine with frequent nocturia

records.short_summary_zh: 腎陰虧虛，髓海失充，虛熱內生。以腰膝痠軟、頭暈耳鳴、失眠多夢、五心煩熱、潮熱盜汗、咽乾口燥為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Deficiency of Kidney Yin failing to nourish the marrow and generating internal Deficiency-Heat. Characterized by lumbar/knee soreness, tinnitus, insomnia, five-center heat, and night sweats.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 腎系本虛病機：腰膝痠軟、耳鳴、虛熱（潮熱盜汗手足心熱）為三大診斷要點。為更年期、慢性腎病核心。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Kidney System Root Deficiency: Lumbar soreness, tinnitus, and deficiency-heat are key diagnostic features. Core pattern in menopausal syndrome.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr TCM Pathology & NCCAOM 考點：代表方六味地黃丸 (Liu Wei Di Huang Wan)。君藥熟地黃滋補腎陰，臣藥山茱萸、山藥，佐藥澤瀉、丹皮、茯苓三瀉三補。
records.tongue_zh: 舌質紅，少苔或無苔少津
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with scanty or absent coating
records.pulse_en: Fine and rapid pulse, especially in the Chi position

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 腎陰虛見五心煩熱、盜汗等虛熱之象;腎陽虛見畏寒肢冷、五更瀉等虛寒之象。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Kidney Yin Deficiency shows deficiency-heat signs; Kidney Yang Deficiency shows deficiency-cold signs.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

key_signs_en: Sore, weak low back and knees
records.mechanism_zh: 腎陰虧虛，精髓失養且陰不制陽，故見腰膝痠軟、耳鳴眩暈與潮熱盜汗等虛熱表現。
records.mechanism_en: Depleted Kidney Yin fails to nourish Essence and Marrow or restrain Yang, producing weak sore lumbar and knees, tinnitus, dizziness, and Deficiency-Heat signs such as tidal fever and night sweats.
records.progression_zh: 腎陰進一步虧耗可發展為虛火，亦可失於滋養肝陰或無力潛制肝陽。
records.progression_en: Further depletion of Kidney Yin may generate Deficiency Fire, fail to nourish Liver Yin, or fail to anchor Liver Yang.

records.treatment_principle_en: Replenish essence and marrow
supporting_signs_en: Sore, weak low back and knees
Brittle bones or weak lower limbs
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 腎藏精,主生長發育與生殖。稟賦不足或後天久病耗傷腎精,精不化髓,腦髓失充,骨骼失養,故見發育遲緩、早衰、健忘、齒搖髮脫、不孕不育。
records.mechanism_en: The Kidney stores Essence (Jing) and governs growth, development, and reproduction. Congenital weakness or chronic illness consuming Kidney Essence leaves the marrow and brain unfilled and the bones unnourished — producing delayed development, premature aging, poor memory, loose teeth, hair loss, and infertility.
records.common_causes_zh: 稟賦不足、房勞過度、久病及腎、年老精氣自衰
records.common_causes_en: Congenital weakness, excessive sexual activity, chronic illness reaching the Kidney, age-related decline of Essence
records.progression_zh: 精不化氣可及腎氣虛、腎陽虛;精不養陰可及腎陰虛;精虧髓虛日久可致骨痿。
records.progression_en: Essence deficiency can extend to Kidney Qi or Yang deficiency, or to Kidney Yin deficiency if it fails to nourish Yin; prolonged Essence-Marrow deficiency can lead to bone wasting.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 腎精不足以發育遲緩、早衰、齒搖髮脫等精髓虧虛表現為主,無明顯熱象;腎陰虛兼見五心煩熱、盜汗等虛熱表現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Kidney Essence Deficiency centers on Essence-Marrow depletion signs (delayed development, premature aging) without heat signs; Kidney Yin Deficiency additionally shows deficiency-heat signs.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 腎精不足以生長發育與生殖功能減退為核心;腎陽虛以畏寒肢冷、五更瀉等溫煦失職表現為核心,二者常兼夾。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Kidney Essence Deficiency centers on impaired growth/reproduction; Kidney Yang Deficiency centers on impaired warming function (cold limbs, early-morning diarrhea) — the two often coexist.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Secure kidney qi
supporting_signs_en: Sore, weak low back and knees
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 腎氣虧虛,固攝封藏失職,故見小便頻數清長或遺尿、滑精早洩、帶下清稀;腎氣不固胞胎,故胎動易滑。
records.mechanism_en: Kidney Qi deficiency impairs its function of securing and storing — producing frequent clear urination or enuresis, spermatorrhea, thin vaginal discharge, and (in pregnancy) a tendency toward miscarriage from failure to secure the fetus.
records.common_causes_zh: 先天稟賦不足、年老腎氣漸衰、房勞過度、久病傷腎
records.common_causes_en: Congenital weakness, age-related decline of Kidney Qi, excessive sexual activity, chronic illness injuring the Kidney
records.progression_zh: 腎氣不固日久,氣損及陽,可發展為腎陽虛;攝納失職日久可及腎不納氣。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Kidney Qi Not Firm can extend to Yang, progressing to Kidney Yang Deficiency; prolonged failure of the securing function can extend to Kidney Failing to Grasp Qi.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 腎氣不固以固攝失職(遺尿、滑精、帶下清稀)為核心;腎陽虛兼見畏寒肢冷、五更瀉等溫煦失職表現,程度更重。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Kidney Qi Not Firm centers on failure of the securing function; Kidney Yang Deficiency additionally shows impaired warming (cold limbs, early-morning diarrhea) and is more severe.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Supplement the kidney to absorb qi
supporting_signs_en: Sore, weak low back and knees
Cold limbs, aversion to cold may accompany
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 肺主呼氣,腎主納氣。久病咳喘傷及腎氣,腎失攝納,氣浮於上,故呼多吸少、動則喘甚;衛外不固,故自汗。
records.mechanism_en: The Lung governs exhalation while the Kidney governs the grasping of Qi (inhalation). Chronic cough/wheezing injures Kidney Qi, so the Kidney fails to grasp Qi and it floats upward — producing predominant exhalation over inhalation and dyspnea worse with exertion, with spontaneous sweating from a weakened defensive layer.
records.common_causes_zh: 久病咳喘、肺氣虛日久及腎、年老腎氣衰
records.common_causes_en: Chronic cough/wheezing, long-standing Lung Qi deficiency extending to the Kidney, age-related Kidney Qi decline
records.progression_zh: 多由肺氣虛或腎氣虛發展而來;氣虛及陽,可發展為腎陽虛;病情危重時可見氣脫。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Lung or Kidney Qi deficiency; if Qi deficiency extends to Yang it can progress to Kidney Yang Deficiency; in critical cases Qi collapse can occur.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 腎不納氣以動則喘甚、呼多吸少為特徵性表現;肺氣虛以咳嗽無力、氣短為主,活動後喘促不如腎不納氣顯著。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Kidney Failing to Grasp Qi is distinguished by dyspnea markedly worse with exertion and difficulty inhaling; Lung Qi Deficiency shows a weak cough and mild breathlessness without this exertional pattern.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Restore heart-kidney communication
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with little coating
records.mechanism_zh: 腎陰不足,不能上濟心火;心火獨亢,不能下溫腎水,水火失濟,心腎不交,故見心煩失眠、心悸健忘與腰膝痠軟、耳鳴等腎陰虛表現並見。
records.mechanism_en: Kidney Yin deficiency fails to rise and nourish the Heart, while Heart Fire, unchecked, fails to descend and warm Kidney Water — this failure of Water-Fire interaction produces insomnia and palpitations alongside Kidney Yin deficiency signs such as low-back soreness and tinnitus.
records.common_causes_zh: 久病傷腎、房勞過度、情志化火暗耗腎陰、年老腎陰漸虧
records.common_causes_en: Chronic illness injuring the Kidney, excessive sexual activity, emotional fire quietly consuming Kidney Yin, age-related Kidney Yin decline
records.progression_zh: 多由心陰虛或腎陰虛單獨發展、日久相互累及而成;若心火益甚,可與心火亢盛並見。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops when isolated Heart Yin or Kidney Yin deficiency progresses and involves the other organ; if Heart Fire intensifies it may coexist with frank Heart Fire.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心腎不交兼見腰膝痠軟、耳鳴等腎陰虛表現;心陰虛病位局限於心,無明顯腎系症狀。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart-Kidney Not Communicating adds Kidney Yin deficiency signs (low-back soreness, tinnitus) to the Heart Yin deficiency picture; Heart Yin Deficiency alone lacks Kidney-system signs.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Supplement heart and spleen, nourish blood, calm the spirit
aliases_en: Heart and Spleen Deficiency of Qi and Blood
records.short_summary_zh: 心血不足，神失所養，脾氣虛弱，運化失職。以心悸怔忡、失眠多夢、健忘、食少體倦、面色萎黃為主要臨床特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Deficiency of Heart Blood depriving the Spirit of nourishment, combined with Spleen Qi deficiency impairing transportation and transformation. Characterized by palpitations, insomnia, poor memory, fatigue, and sallow complexion.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 雙重虛證：心不主血、脾不統血與生血不足並見。常用於心悸、失眠、月經過多、崩漏等氣血兩虛證候。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Dual Deficiency: Failure of Heart to govern Blood and Spleen to produce/control Blood. Commonly seen in insomnia, palpitations, hypermenorrhea, and chronic bleeding.
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue with thin white coating

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 心脾兩虛兼見食少、便溏、倦怠等脾氣虛表現;心血虛病位偏心,無明顯脾系症狀。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heart-Spleen Deficiency adds Spleen Qi signs (poor appetite, loose stools, fatigue) to the Heart Blood deficiency picture; Heart Blood Deficiency alone is centered on the Heart.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Course the liver, fortify the spleen
records.tongue_en: White tongue coating
records.mechanism_zh: 肝失疏泄,橫逆犯脾,脾失健運,故見脅脹、腹脹便溏、腸鳴矢氣,諸症每因情志波動而加重,是「木旺乘土」的典型表現。
records.mechanism_en: The Liver's impaired free-flow of Qi invades the Spleen horizontally, impairing its transportation function — producing hypochondriac distention, abdominal fullness with loose stools, and borborygmus, all worsened by emotional stress; the classic 'Wood overacting on Earth' mechanism.
records.common_causes_zh: 情志不遂、肝氣鬱結犯脾、脾胃素虛易受肝乘
records.common_causes_en: Unresolved emotional stress, Liver Qi Stagnation invading the Spleen, underlying Spleen weakness making it vulnerable to Liver invasion
records.progression_zh: 多由肝氣鬱結發展而來;脾虛日久可累及氣血生化,形成氣血兩虛。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Liver Qi Stagnation; prolonged Spleen deficiency can impair Qi-Blood production, leading to combined Qi-Blood deficiency.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝脾不和在肝氣鬱結基礎上兼見腹脹便溏、腸鳴等脾虛/脾受克表現;肝氣鬱結病位偏肝,無明顯脾系症狀。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver-Spleen Disharmony adds Spleen signs (abdominal distention, loose stools, borborygmus) to the Liver Qi Stagnation picture; Liver Qi Stagnation alone is centered on the Liver.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝脾不和以腹瀉便溏為主要表現;肝胃不和以胃脘脹痛、噯氣吞酸、嘔逆等胃氣上逆表現為主。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Liver-Spleen Disharmony centers on diarrhea/loose stools; Liver-Stomach Disharmony centers on epigastric pain, belching, and acid reflux from rebellious Stomach Qi.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Liver Qi Stagnation; prolonged stagnation can transform into Liver-Stomach heat; chronic impairment can injure Stomach Yin.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肝胃不和以胃脘脹痛、噯氣吞酸、嘔逆為主;肝脾不和以腹脹便溏、腸鳴為主。

records.tongue_en: Red, dry tongue with no coating
records.mechanism_zh: 肺腎陰液互資,金水相生。久咳傷肺陰,下汲腎陰,或腎陰虛不能上滋肺陰,終致肺腎兩虧,虛火內熾,故見乾咳少痰、痰中帶血、骨蒸潮熱、盜汗顴紅。
records.mechanism_en: The Lung and Kidney mutually nourish each other's Yin ('Metal generates Water'). Chronic cough injuring Lung Yin can draw on Kidney Yin, or Kidney Yin deficiency can fail to nourish the Lung — eventually both organs become Yin-deficient with internal deficiency fire, producing a dry cough with blood-streaked sputum, tidal fever, night sweats, and malar flush.
records.common_causes_zh: 久咳傷陰、肺癆日久、房勞過度傷腎陰、年老陰液漸虧
records.common_causes_en: Chronic cough injuring Yin, prolonged consumptive cough (Lung Wilting), excessive sexual activity injuring Kidney Yin, age-related Yin decline
records.progression_zh: 多由肺陰虛或腎陰虛單獨發展、日久相互累及而成;虛火灼傷肺絡可致反覆咯血。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops when isolated Lung Yin or Kidney Yin deficiency progresses and involves the other organ; deficiency fire scorching the Lung vessels can cause recurrent hemoptysis.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肺腎陰虛兼見腰膝痠軟等腎陰虛表現;肺陰虛病位局限於肺,無明顯腎系症狀。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Lung-Kidney Yin Deficiency adds Kidney Yin signs (sore low back/knees) to the Lung Yin deficiency picture; Lung Yin Deficiency alone lacks Kidney-system signs.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 肺腎陰虛以乾咳痰血等肺系表現為突出;腎陰虛以腰膝痠軟、耳鳴為主,無明顯肺系症狀。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Lung-Kidney Yin Deficiency is distinguished by prominent Lung-system signs (dry cough, blood-streaked sputum); Kidney Yin Deficiency alone lacks Lung-system signs.

records.treatment_principle_en: Warm and supplement spleen and kidney yang
key_signs_en: Cold, aching low back and knees
Undigested food in loose stools, or edema
records.tongue_en: Pale, swollen tongue with a white, slippery coating
records.mechanism_zh: 脾陽久虛,不能溫養腎陽,或腎陽虛衰不能溫煦脾土,終致脾腎陽氣俱虛,火不暖土,水濕不化,故見畏寒肢冷、五更瀉、水腫、小便不利等。
records.mechanism_en: Prolonged Spleen Yang deficiency fails to nourish Kidney Yang, or primary Kidney Yang decline fails to warm the Spleen — eventually both organs' Yang become deficient, fluids fail to transform, producing cold limbs, early-morning diarrhea, edema, and urinary dysfunction.
records.common_causes_zh: 脾陽虛遷延及腎、久病傷陽、年老命門火衰、房勞過度
records.common_causes_en: Prolonged Spleen Yang Deficiency extending to the Kidney, chronic illness injuring Yang, age-related decline of Life Gate Fire, excessive sexual activity
records.progression_zh: 多由脾陽虛或腎陽虛單獨發展、日久相互累及而成;陽虛甚者可致陽氣暴脫。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops when isolated Spleen Yang or Kidney Yang deficiency progresses and involves the other organ; severe cases can precipitate Yang collapse.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 脾腎陽虛兼見腰膝冷痛痠軟、夜尿清長等腎陽虛表現;脾陽虛病位局限於脾,無明顯腎系症狀。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Spleen-Kidney Yang Deficiency adds Kidney Yang signs (cold low-back pain, frequent clear nighttime urination) to the Spleen Yang deficiency picture; Spleen Yang Deficiency alone lacks Kidney-system signs.

records.treatment_principle_en: Move qi, invigorate blood, dispel stasis
key_signs_en: Both distending and stabbing pain present
records.tongue_en: Dusky tongue, or with stasis spots
records.mechanism_zh: 氣為血帥,氣滯則血行不暢,日久血行瘀阻,故先見脹痛(氣滯)後見刺痛固定(血瘀),二者互為因果,常同時並見。
records.mechanism_en: Qi commands the movement of Blood; Qi stagnation impairs Blood flow and, over time, produces Blood Stasis — so distending pain (Qi stagnation) and fixed stabbing pain (Blood Stasis) coexist and reinforce each other.
records.common_causes_zh: 情志不遂氣滯日久、外傷、久病入絡
records.common_causes_en: Prolonged emotional stress causing Qi stagnation, trauma, chronic illness entering the collaterals
records.progression_zh: 多由肝氣鬱結或情志不遂發展而來;瘀阻日久可形成癥積。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Liver Qi Stagnation or unresolved emotional stress; prolonged stasis can form abdominal masses.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 氣滯血瘀在肝氣鬱結基礎上進一步出現刺痛固定、舌暗瘀點;肝氣鬱結以脹痛遊走、脈弦為主,無瘀血之象。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Qi Stagnation with Blood Stasis adds fixed stabbing pain and a dusky tongue with stasis spots to the Liver Qi Stagnation picture; Liver Qi Stagnation alone shows migrating distending pain without stasis signs.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Boost qi and nourish blood
key_signs_en: Mental fatigue and lack of strength
records.tongue_en: Pale tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 氣血同源,互根互用。脾氣虛弱,生化乏源,或久病失血,氣隨血耗,終致氣血俱虛,臟腑經脈失養,故見神疲乏力、面色淡白、心悸失眠。
records.mechanism_en: Qi and Blood share a common source and mutually generate each other. Spleen Qi weakness impairs Blood production, or chronic blood loss depletes Qi alongside Blood, eventually leaving both deficient and the organs undernourished — producing fatigue, pallor, palpitations, and insomnia.
records.common_causes_zh: 脾胃虛弱生化不足、久病失血、思慮勞倦耗傷氣血
records.common_causes_en: Spleen-Stomach weakness impairing production, chronic blood loss, excessive mental/physical strain consuming Qi and Blood
records.progression_zh: 多由脾氣虛、心血虛或失血病證發展而來;氣血兩虛日久可累及陰陽,形成陰陽俱虛。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Spleen Qi Deficiency, Heart Blood Deficiency, or blood-loss conditions; prolonged Qi-Blood deficiency can extend to Yin-Yang deficiency.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 氣血兩虛為全身性氣血俱虛,無明確臟腑定位;心脾兩虛病位明確在心脾,兼見心悸失眠與食少便溏並重。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Qi and Blood Deficiency is a generalized systemic deficiency without a specific organ location; Heart-Spleen Deficiency is specifically located in the Heart and Spleen with equally prominent palpitations/insomnia and poor appetite/loose stools.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Invigorate blood, dispel stasis
records.short_summary_zh: 血行不暢，瘀滯內阻，脈絡不通。以刺痛、痛有定處、夜間痛甚、拒按、唇舌紫暗或有瘀點瘀斑為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Blood circulation impaired, resulting in localized stasis obstructing collaterals. Characterized by fixed sharp stabbing pain, nocturnal aggravation, tenderness to touch, and purple lips/tongue with macules.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 血分實證：痛如針刺、痛有定處、夜間加重為三大診斷要點。可因氣滯、寒凝、熱灼或創傷引發。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Blood Level Excess: Sharp stabbing pain, fixed location, and night aggravation are three key diagnostic indicators. Caused by Qi stagnation, Cold, Heat, or trauma.
records.tongue_zh: 舌質紫暗，或有瘀點瘀斑
records.tongue_en: Purple or dark tongue with stasis dots/macules
records.pulse_en: Fine and choppy pulse, or bound/intermittent
key_signs_en: Fixed stabbing pain, worse with pressure

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear heat, cool the blood
supporting_signs_en: Confusion/delirium may occur in severe cases
records.tongue_en: Deep red or purple-red, dry tongue
records.mechanism_zh: 熱入血分,迫血妄行,血溢脈外,故見出血色鮮紅、皮膚斑疹;熱擾心神,故心煩;熱盛動血甚者可見神昏譫語。
records.mechanism_en: Heat entering the Blood level forces Blood to move recklessly outside the vessels, producing bright red bleeding and skin rashes; heat disturbing the Shen produces irritability, and in severe cases can cause confusion/delirium.
records.common_causes_zh: 外感熱邪入血分、情志化火迫血、過食辛辣助熱
records.common_causes_en: External heat pathogen penetrating to the Blood level, emotional fire forcing Blood to move, excessive spicy food fueling heat
records.progression_zh: 熱盛動血日久可致陰血兩傷;深入營血可見溫病營血分重症。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Blood Heat can injure both Yin and Blood; deeper penetration can present as a severe Ying/Xue-level warm-disease pattern.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 血熱以出血色鮮紅、舌紅絳、脈數為主,屬熱迫血行;血瘀以刺痛固定、舌紫暗、脈澀為主,屬血行不暢,二者病機不同但可相繼出現。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Blood Heat shows bright red bleeding with a red tongue and rapid pulse — Heat forcing Blood; Blood Stasis shows fixed stabbing pain with a dusky tongue and choppy pulse — impaired Blood flow. Different mechanisms, though one can follow the other.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear heat, drain damp from the lower burner
supporting_signs_en: Low-back pain or fever may accompany
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with yellow, greasy coating
records.mechanism_zh: 濕熱蘊結下焦,膀胱氣化不利,故見小便頻急澀痛、尿黃赤;濕熱下注前陰,故帶下黃稠臭穢、陰部濕癢。
records.mechanism_en: Damp-Heat accumulates in the Lower Burner and impairs the Bladder's Qi transformation, producing urgent, frequent, painful urination with dark urine; Damp-Heat descending to the genitals produces thick, foul, yellow discharge and itching.
records.common_causes_zh: 外感濕熱之邪、嗜食肥甘、外陰不潔、肝經濕熱下注
records.common_causes_en: External Damp-Heat invasion, excessive rich food, poor genital hygiene, Liver-channel Damp-Heat descending
records.progression_zh: 濕熱下注日久可致淋證反覆發作;上蒙可與肝膽濕熱並見。
records.progression_en: Prolonged Lower-Burner Damp-Heat can cause recurrent Lin (dysuria) syndromes; it may coexist with Liver-Gallbladder Damp-Heat.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 下焦濕熱病位偏下焦(尿頻尿痛、帶下);肝膽濕熱病位偏上中焦(脅肋脹痛、口苦、黃疸),二者可同時並見。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Lower-Burner Damp-Heat is centered on the lower burner (urinary/genital signs); Liver-Gallbladder Damp-Heat is centered on the upper/middle burner (hypochondriac pain, jaundice) — the two may coexist.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 下焦濕熱為廣義濕熱下注病機;熱淋是其在膀胱的具體淋證表現,以小便灼熱刺痛、急迫為核心。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Lower-Burner Damp-Heat is the broader mechanism; Heat Lin is its specific presentation as a Bladder dysuria syndrome, centered on burning, stabbing, urgent urination.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.treatment_principle_en: Dry damp, transform phlegm
records.short_summary_zh: 脾失健運，水濕不化，凝聚成痰，阻滯氣機。以形體肥胖、身重困倦、胸悶脘痞、咳嗽痰多白黏、口黏不渴為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Spleen failing to transform fluids, leading to moisture accumulating into phlegm and obstructing Qi movement. Characterized by heaviness, obesity, chest fullness, profuse white sticky sputum, and sticky mouth.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 實證病機：脾不運化為本，痰濕聚積為標。常表現為胸悶、噁心、咳嗽痰多、眩暈或肥胖症。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Excess Pattern: Spleen dysfunction as root, phlegm-damp accumulation as branch. Commonly manifests as chest oppression, nausea, heavy cough, dizziness, or metabolic issues.
records.tongue_en: Swollen tongue with thick white greasy coating

records.treatment_principle_zh: 祛風散寒除濕，通絡止痛
records.treatment_principle_en: Dispel wind-cold-damp, unblock the channels
key_signs_en: Worse with cold, relieved by warmth
records.tongue_en: White, greasy tongue coating
records.mechanism_zh: 風寒濕三氣雜至,合而為痺,閉阻經絡氣血,故見關節肌肉疼痛;風邪偏勝則痛處遊走,寒邪偏勝則痛劇、遇寒加重,濕邪偏勝則重著、痛處固定。
records.mechanism_en: Wind, Cold, and Dampness combine to obstruct the channels and Qi-Blood flow, producing joint and muscle pain; a predominance of Wind causes migrating pain, Cold causes severe pain worse with cold, and Dampness causes fixed heaviness.
records.common_causes_zh: 居處潮濕、氣候驟變、感受風寒濕邪、體虛衛外不固
records.common_causes_en: Damp living conditions, sudden weather change, exposure to Wind-Cold-Damp, weakened defensive Qi
records.progression_zh: 痺證日久不癒,可內傳臟腑(五臟痺);風寒濕痺鬱久可化熱,轉為熱痺。
records.progression_en: Prolonged, unresolved Bi can penetrate to the internal organs (organ Bi); it can also transform into heat, becoming Heat Bi.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 風寒濕痺關節不紅不熱、遇寒加重、苔白膩,屬寒濕;熱痺關節紅腫熱痛、得涼則舒、苔黃,屬熱。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Wind-Cold-Damp Bi shows joints that are neither red nor hot, worse with cold, with a white greasy coating; Heat Bi shows red, swollen, hot joints relieved by cold, with a yellow coating.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.tongue_en: Red tongue with yellow coating
records.mechanism_zh: 風寒濕痺鬱久化熱,或素體陽盛,感邪後從熱化,熱壅經絡關節,氣血壅滯,故見關節紅腫熱痛、得涼則舒。
records.mechanism_en: Wind-Cold-Damp Bi transforming into heat over time, or a constitutionally Yang-excess body transforming an invading pathogen into heat, obstructs the channels and joints with heat — producing red, swollen, hot, painful joints relieved by cold.
records.common_causes_zh: 風寒濕痺鬱久化熱、素體陽盛或陰虛內熱、外感熱邪
records.common_causes_en: Prolonged Wind-Cold-Damp Bi transforming into heat, constitutional Yang excess or Yin-deficient internal heat, external heat invasion
records.progression_zh: 多由風寒濕痺化熱而來;熱毒熾盛可致關節變形之頑痺重證。
records.progression_en: Commonly develops from Wind-Cold-Damp Bi transforming into heat; intense heat-toxin can progress to a severe, deforming chronic Bi.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 熱痺關節紅腫熱痛、得涼則舒、苔黃,屬熱;風寒濕痺關節不紅不熱、遇寒加重、苔白膩,屬寒濕。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heat Bi shows red, hot, swollen joints relieved by cold with a yellow coating; Wind-Cold-Damp Bi shows joints that are not red or hot, worse with cold, with a white greasy coating.

records.treatment_principle_en: Regulate the Chong and Ren vessels
key_signs_en: Lower-abdominal symptoms varying with the menstrual cycle
supporting_signs_en: Presentation varies with the underlying concurrent pattern
Often triggered by emotional or organ-level disharmony
records.tongue_en: Varies with the underlying concurrent pattern
records.mechanism_zh: 衝為血海,任主胞胎,衝任二脈與肝、腎、脾關係密切。臟腑氣血失調(肝鬱、脾虛、腎虛等)累及衝任,使其蓄溢失常,故見月經週期紊亂、經量異常、不孕等。此為一組繼發性病機,須辨明背後臟腑根本證候。
records.mechanism_en: The Chong vessel is the 'Sea of Blood' and the Ren vessel governs the uterus/fetus; both are closely tied to the Liver, Kidney, and Spleen. Disharmony of these organs' Qi-Blood (Liver stagnation, Spleen deficiency, Kidney deficiency) disturbs the Chong-Ren vessels' storage and release, producing irregular cycles, abnormal flow, and infertility. This is a secondary mechanism — the underlying organ-level Pattern must be identified.
records.common_causes_zh: 肝鬱、脾腎虧虛、多產房勞、情志失調
records.common_causes_en: Liver stagnation, Spleen/Kidney deficiency, multiple pregnancies or excessive sexual activity, emotional disturbance
records.progression_zh: 常繼發於肝氣鬱結、脾腎兩虛、氣血兩虛等證;失治日久可致崩漏或不孕。
records.progression_en: Commonly secondary to Liver Qi Stagnation, Spleen-Kidney deficiency, or Qi-Blood deficiency; if untreated it can lead to abnormal uterine bleeding or infertility.

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 衝任失調是月經/生殖系統的功能性病機描述,須結合具體臟腑證候(如氣血兩虛、腎虛)辨證;不應作為獨立終點診斷。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Chong-Ren Disharmony describes a functional reproductive-system mechanism that must be diagnosed together with the underlying organ pattern (e.g. Qi-Blood Deficiency, Kidney Deficiency) — it should not stand alone as a final diagnosis.

records.short_summary_zh: 濕熱蘊結下焦，膀胱氣化失司。以小便頻急刺痛、尿色黃赤短少、小腹急痛、發熱惡寒為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Damp-Heat accumulating in the Lower Burner, impairing Bladder Qi transformation. Characterized by frequent, urgent, burning urination with dark, scanty urine and lower abdominal distension.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 下焦實熱證：以小便頻急灼熱、刺痛短赤為診斷要點。多因飲食不節（過食辛辣油脂飲酒）或外感濕熱下注引發。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Lower Burner Excess Heat: Burning urgent dysuria is key diagnostic criteria. Triggered by greasy spicy food, alcohol, or external Damp-Heat invasion.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr MM2 & NCCAOM 考點：代表方八正散（八正散 = 滑石、木通、車前子、萁麥、萁蓄、梔子、大黃、甘草）。核心草藥：滑石、木通、車前子、梔子、燈心草。
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Heat, drain Dampness, unblock urination
records.tongue_en: Red tongue body with yellow greasy coating

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 熱淋以小便頻急灼痛為主,無砂石排出;石淋兼見腰腹絞痛、尿中夾砂石。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heat Lin shows urgent burning urination without gravel; Stone Lin additionally shows colicky flank pain and passage of sand/stones.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

differential_patterns.distinguishing_zh: 熱淋為實熱證,起病急,苔黃膩、脈滑數;勞淋為虛證,病程久,遇勞即發,脈沉細無力。
differential_patterns.distinguishing_en: Heat Lin is an acute excess-heat pattern; Fatigue Lin is a chronic deficiency pattern triggered by exertion, with a deep, thready, weak pulse.
differential_patterns.source: TCM textbook standard (Maciocia, Foundations of Chinese Medicine; 中醫診斷學 藏象辨證通說)

records.mechanism_zh: 濕熱蘊結下焦，膀胱氣化不利，故小便頻急、灼熱刺痛而色黃赤短少。
records.mechanism_en: Damp-Heat accumulating in the Lower Burner obstructs Bladder Qi transformation, causing frequent urgent urination with burning pain and dark, scanty urine.
records.common_causes_zh: 過食辛辣油膩或飲酒；外感濕熱下注。
records.common_causes_en: Excessive spicy or greasy food or alcohol; externally contracted Damp-Heat pouring downward.

records.short_summary_zh: 濕熱久蘊下焦，煎熬尿液，凝結成砂石。以腰腹絞痛、尿中夾砂石或血尿、尿道刺痛為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Damp-Heat long accumulating in the Lower Burner, condensing urine into sand or stones. Characterized by severe colicky flank/abdominal pain, sand in urine, or hematuria.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 實證砂石病機：腰腹陣發性絞痛、痛引少腹、排出砂石為三大診斷要點。當加「軟堅散結排石」藥。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Excess Stone Pathomechanism: Paroxysmal colicky flank pain radiating to groin and presence of gravel. Requires herbs that soften hardness and dissolve stones.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Maciocia & Bastyr 考點：必加軟堅排石核心藥對「金錢草、海金沙、雞內金」。代表方三金湯、石韋散。
records.treatment_principle_zh: 清熱利濕，通淋排石，止痛
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Heat, drain Damp, promote urination, expel stones, relieve pain
records.tongue_en: Red tongue with thick yellow greasy coating
records.mechanism_zh: 濕熱久蘊下焦，煎熬尿液而凝結為砂石，阻滯尿路則見腰腹絞痛、尿道刺痛或血尿。
records.mechanism_en: Prolonged Damp-Heat in the Lower Burner concentrates urine into sand or stones; obstruction of the urinary passage produces colicky flank-abdominal pain, urethral pain, or hematuria.
supporting_signs_en: Pain radiating to the lower abdomen or genitals
Passage of sand or stones in urine
